description: 公園近くの自転車道で、女子学生の自転車のチェーンが外れてしまい、彼女が困った表情で自転車を見ている。友人の男子学生がしゃがんでチェーンを直そうとしており、別の友人はスマートフォンで修理方法を調べている。背景では、子どもが自転車で水たまりに入り服を濡らし、ジョギング中の男性が落としたイヤホンを探している。さらに、犬がリードを引っ張って飼い主を困らせ、ベンチでは高齢の男性が転んだ少年の膝にばんそうこうを貼っている。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show a busy bicycle path beside a green urban park on a bright weekend afternoon. The main event should be very clear in the foreground: a teenage schoolgirl is standing beside her bicycle with a worried and frustrated expression because the bicycle chain has come off the gears. The loose chain should be clearly visible. A teenage boy, her friend, is crouching beside the rear wheel and carefully trying to put the chain back on. Another teenage friend is standing nearby and using a smartphone, apparently searching online for instructions on how to repair the bicycle. Include several clear background sub-stories happening at the same time. On the left, a young child has ridden a bicycle through a large puddle and splashed muddy water onto his clothes while his surprised parent reacts nearby. In the middle background, a male jogger has stopped and is looking around the ground because he has dropped one of his wireless earphones. On the right, an excited dog is pulling strongly on its leash while its owner leans backward and struggles to control it. Near a park bench, a young boy with a scraped knee is sitting down while an elderly man carefully puts a bandage on the injury. Include bicycles, bicycle helmets, a water bottle, park benches, trees, a walking path, a puddle, a small repair tool, smartphones, runners, families, and park visitors. Make all facial expressions and actions visually distinct and easy to describe. Clear foreground, middle ground, and background, approximately 9 to 12 visible people plus one dog. No speech bubbles, no captions, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, detailed but uncluttered and suitable for an English speaking test.
